items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Because I knew Nat King Cole from Chicago. You remember when his brother and he organized a band, Eddie Cole left... and came back to Chicago.

ctx.x: That's right. And I took my horn out and you know, for the cats we blew with them, what not, hung out. Because I knew Nat King Cole from Chicago. You remember when his brother and he organized a band, Eddie Cole left (Unintelligible) and came back to Chicago.
